items.label: SOLAR OUTDOOR LIGHTS
items.value: Gigalumi solar lights are powered by the sun.They automatically charge during the day, over a period of 6-8 hours. Then, they turn on automatically at night, providing at least 8H of lighting.A suitable choose for beautifying the garden or as a perfect gift for family and friends

items.label: PERFECT PERFORMANCE
items.value: Differentiates with other similar products, our solar yard lights are equipped with High-resistance ABS material,2V 30ma Solar panel and 1.2V/1PC 100mAh AAA Ni-MH rechargeable battery.Each Lights is safe and reliable with high-quality,long-endurance and stable work

items.label: ELEGANT OUTDOOR DECORATION
items.value: With attractive and modern design, these bright solar garden lights create an elegant outdoor lighting experience, perfect for your garden, yard, flower bed, terrace, walkway, driveway, or anywhere else

items.label: IP65 WATERPROOF
items.value: With IP65 waterproof rating, the solar yard lights resist rust and corrosion and are well-protected against rain, snow, frost or sleet. Product is designed cut off the moisture and water vapor, therefore the lights entirely resist the penetration of rainwater and snow

items.label: EASY TO INSTALL
items.value: No additional tools, wiring, or power supply is needed. Installation steps is packed in the box.ONLY 3 MINUTES，the installation can be completed. The Solar garden lights turn on at nigh and turn off at dawn automatically

items.label: QUICK START GUIDE
items.value: Ensure the switch is ON, charge in direct sunlight for 4+ hours (new arrivals may need recharging after shipping), and install in a place in direct sunlight (6+ hrs/day, no shade) and away from night light
